messages:
Sam: Quick heads-up — planning a stability sweep dry-run across API / runtime / console / router in staging tonight at 21:00 UTC. Goal: validate telemetry gates, confirm rollback triggers, and test deploy-bot wave sequencing. Pinning: runtime=rev-ec2a, router=2.3.1, console=feature/sync-telemetry. Any objections?

Jules: +1 from runtime side. Will watch KV cache evictions. What are the metrics gates?

Noah: Suggest gates: p95 latency increase >50ms sustained for 3m; error-rate spike >1% absolute for 5m; 5xx counts >50/min.

Maria: Add traces sampling smoke — make sure console traces include router tag. Also we need a note in release notes about the small response-schema bump.

deploy-bot: Scheduled dry-run created: /deploy run --wave=staging-dry-telemetry --variants="runtime=rev-ec2a,router=2.3.1,console=feature/sync-telemetry" --rollout=canary:10%,30m; canary-checks={p95:<=+50ms,errors:<=1%} --on-failure=rollback

Emily: Can we run a quick metric-baseline 15m before start? I can kick that off at 20:40 UTC.

Sam: Yes please @Emily — baseline at 20:40. Also @Jules will you pin the runtime flavor in the deploy config? I can update release notes with the schema line.

Jules: Pinned runtime flavor in config repo. PR: https://github.com/redwood/configs/pull/412 — includes healthcheck tweaks.

Noah: FYI: rollback criteria clarified — immediate rollback if errors >1% for two consecutive 5m windows OR if p95 jumps >100ms for any 5m window. Otherwise we keep canary and extend observation.

Maria: I'll validate trace tags after baseline and before canary. If tracing missing, hold the rollout.

Sam: Plan: baseline @20:40, dry-run kickoff @21:00. Deploy-bot will post status to this thread. If no blockers by 20:50 I'll proceed. :thumbsup:

Emily: baseline done at 20:55 — looks clean. p95 steady, 5xx ~0.02%.

Sam: No objections — kicking it off in 5.

deploy-bot: wave started: staging-dry-telemetry — canary 10% -> 30m window. Tracking: p95, errors, traces. Link: https://deploys.internal/redwood/waves/1805055050

Jules: seeing slight p95 blip +12ms during canary ramp, within gate.

Noah: monitoring — no error spike.

Sam: If canary stays green at 30m we will extend to 50% for another 20m. I'll post final results and add to release notes.

Maria: traces present and contain router.tag = "v2.3.1".

deploy-bot: canary OK — thresholds met. Advancing to 50%.

Emily: continuing to monitor metrics dashboard.

Sam: Final: canary completed, no rollbacks triggered. Results: p95 +8ms, errors +0.01%. Release notes updated with schema bump and runtime pin. Thanks team. :tada:
